image_description:
## 1. Chart type
- **Connected dot plot / dumbbell chart** by state, comparing two rates per state.

## 2. Layout techniques
- Uses **two side-by-side columns** of state rows to fit many categories.
- Each row is a **paired-point comparison** connected by a light horizontal line.
- No faceting in the strict sense, no stacking, and no small multiples.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| State | Categorical/nominal | Row position; text label at left of each row |
| Case rate in entire state | Quantitative | Horizontal position of gray dot; numeric label near gray dot |
| Case rate in state prisons | Quantitative | Horizontal position of orange dot; numeric label near orange dot |
| Gap / ratio between prison and state rates (e.g., “9.0x”) | Quantitative | Text label centered on connecting line |
| Comparison category (entire state vs. state prisons) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue (gray vs. orange); column headers above dots |
